metadata.title: Trans-Sasakian space forms
metadata.abstract: In this paper, we derive an explicit expression for the Riemann--Christoffel curvature tensor of a trans-Sasakian manifold with pointwise constant $\varphi$-sectional curvature and introduce the notion of trans-Sasakian space forms. As consequences, we obtain explicit formulas for the Ricci tensor and the scalar curvature. We further prove that every $3$-dimensional trans-Sasakian manifold necessarily has pointwise constant $\varphi$-sectional curvature. In addition, we investigate statistical structures on trans-Sasakian manifolds and introduce the notion of trans-Sasakian statistical space forms. We then establish a classification of such statistical structures. Our results show that every trans-Sasakian statistical space form of dimension greater than $3$ is necessarily almost-trivial. In the $3$-dimensional case, we establish a rigidity theorem for trans-Sasakian statistical space forms and provide explicit examples showing the existence of non-trivial $3$-dimensional trans-Sasakian statistical space forms

analysis.topic: 黎曼、亚黎曼、Finsler及特殊几何结构
analysis.progressType: 曲率公式与特殊结构分类
analysis.workSummary: 对逐点常φ截面曲率的trans-Sasakian流形给出显式Riemann曲率张量，并由此计算Ricci张量和标量曲率。作者说明每个三维trans-Sasakian流形均自动具有逐点常φ截面曲率。进一步引入对应统计空间形式并分类统计结构，维数大于3时必为almost-trivial，三维则有刚性定理及非平凡例子。
techniques: 接触型结构的曲率张量表达
按维数分类及三维实例
analysis.breakthrough: 将trans-Sasakian空间形式的曲率表达与统计结构的维数刚性联系起来。
analysis.limitations: 逐点常φ截面曲率不等同于全局常值；almost-trivial的精确定义及三维刚性假设未在摘要展开。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。

aiReview.note: 对该版本全部可提取页面做 AI 披露关键词检索，并核对命中段落；这不是对整篇数学证明的审读。全文检索与模型名拆行补检未见作者生成式AI使用披露。第10–11页Astra候选分别来自a straightforward、A straightforward的数学英语。第21页致谢仅为研究资助，第21–23页参考文献中的神经网络和流形学习是研究文献。

analysis.priorityReason: 特殊黎曼结构与曲率公式相关，几何流和分析关联较少。
